post.title: Australia declared war on birds… and LOST 🐦
post.description: The Great Emu War of 1932: two machine guns, 10,000 rounds of ammo, and around 20,000 emus. Guess who won.

scenes.narration: In 1932, the Australian army declared war... on a bird. And the bird won.
scenes.tts: In nineteen thirty-two, the Australian army declared war... on a bird. And the bird won.

icons.ai: a proud emu wearing a tiny green army helmet, chest puffed out
icons.name: dodo

scenes.narration: It started after World War One, when thousands of veterans were given land in Western Australia to grow wheat.

icons.ai: a friendly 1920s Australian farmer in a wide-brimmed hat holding a bundle of golden wheat
icons.name: tractor

scenes.narration: Then, around twenty thousand emus showed up... and started eating everything.

icons.ai: a hungry emu greedily eating golden wheat stalks, crumbs flying
icons.name: dodo

scenes.narration: The farmers begged for help. And the government sent... machine guns.

card.ai: comedic scene: 1930s Australian soldiers in slouch hats proudly riding an old farm truck with a vintage machine gun mounted on it, driving into a golden wheat field full of curious emus, bright sunny outback sky

scenes.narration: Major Meredith led the mission, with two Lewis guns and ten thousand rounds of ammunition.

icons.ai: a confident 1930s army major with a big moustache saluting, cartoon, khaki uniform
icons.name: military helmet

scenes.narration: But this is where it gets ridiculous.

icons.ai: an emu raising one eyebrow with a smug grin
icons.name: face with monocle

scenes.narration: The emus split into small groups and ran at up to fifty kilometers per hour. One gun even jammed in the very first ambush.

icons.ai: an emu sprinting at full speed with motion lines, legs blurred
icons.name: dodo

icons.ai: a jammed vintage machine gun puffing a little cloud of smoke, comedic
icons.name: anxious face with sweat

scenes.narration: After about a month, the official count was 986 emus... using 9,860 bullets. That's ten bullets per bird.
scenes.tts: After about a month, the official count was nine hundred eighty-six emus... using nine thousand eight hundred sixty bullets. That's ten bullets per bird.

icons.ai: a pile of empty brass bullet casings next to an exhausted soldier's helmet, comedic
icons.name: military helmet

scenes.narration: The army retreated. Meredith said the emus could face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.

card.ai: a proud emu standing on a hilltop like a victorious general at golden sunset over a wheat field, tiny waving flag, triumphant and funny

scenes.narration: And the farmers? They asked the army for help again in 1934, 1943, and 1948... and were turned down every time.
scenes.tts: And the farmers? They asked the army for help again in nineteen thirty-four, nineteen forty-three, and nineteen forty-eight... and were turned down every time.

icons.ai: a frustrated Australian farmer facepalming next to a smug emu
icons.name: face with tears of joy

scenes.narration: So who really won? Comment Team Emu or Team Army, and follow for more.

icons.ai: a proud emu wearing a tiny green army helmet holding a golden trophy
icons.name: trophy
